post_copy.title: Stop putting foundation on dry skin after 50 ✨ (Do THIS order instead)
post_copy.caption:
I used to spend a fortune on high-end foundations wondering why my makeup looked cakey, separated, and actually made my wrinkles look deeper by 2 PM. 🤦‍♀️

It turns out it wasn't the makeup. It was the order of hydration before anything touches mature skin. When you prep with a lightweight botanical milky essence, your skin gets that bouncy cushion so you only need a fraction of product.

Here is the exact order:
1️⃣ Press a dewy milky essence with open palms (never rub).
2️⃣ Let it sink in for 60 seconds.
3️⃣ Micro-tap hydrating serum concealer only in the inner corner.
4️⃣ Featherlight base that lets your skin breathe.

💬 Comment "YOUTHFUL" and your AGE below, and I'll send you my complete step-by-step mature skin prep guide with the exact products that won't crease!

⚠️ Note: Make sure you're following @botaniqueparis so my message can go through to your inbox!
